name: RC-B10-0471/2025 – After § 8 – Am 3
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on renewing the EU-Africa partnership: building common priorities ahead of the Angola Summit
part_text: 8a. Condemns the persecution of the indigenous Boers in the Republic of South Africa, who are subjected to systematic violence and harassment by the state, including 142 racially discriminatory laws and several hundred murders of Boer farmers per year; demands that the continuation of the EU’s Strategic Partnership with the Republic of South Africa be made conditional upon the Republic of South Africa ending legal discrimination against the Boers, compensating expropriated farmers and the relatives of murdered Boers for the injustices done to them, and establishing effective measures to protect this minority;
